description: Override heartbeat model to use local qwen3.5:4B instead of cloud glm-5.2 for CRO agent, saving cloud token costs on routine monitoring heartbeats
rationale: CRO heartbeat runs every 15 minutes (96 times/day) purely for portfolio monitoring via rh.py scripts. These are simple status checks that the local model can handle. Using glm-5.2:cloud for routine monitoring wastes expensive cloud tokens. Local model costs $0. Cloud model still used for: user conversations, trade decisions, research, daily summaries, escalations. Local model HEARTBEAT.md instructions are written specifically for qwen3.5:4b capability level. This change reduces cloud token spend by ~96 calls/day with zero impact on trading capability.
risk_assessment: LOW - heartbeat model override only affects automated polling runs. Interactive sessions still use primary model (glm-5.2:cloud). If local model struggles, it escalates to Discord per HEARTBEAT.md protocol. No risk to trade execution, user conversations, or other agent functionality.
backup_plan: If local model heartbeats cause issues, remove the model override to revert to cloud model for all heartbeats.
